transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you into the clinic today?

I’m here because things at work have felt off since I got that county safety award. People have been twisting what I write in my inspection reports and asking these pointed questions about budgets, like they’re trying to make me look crooked. My supervisor says it’s normal review, but I can tell there’s a coordinated effort to discredit me.
How long have you been noticing this coordinated effort against you?
About a year now—since I got recognized for that county safety initiative.
Have you ever heard voices, whispering, or other sounds when no one else was around?
No, I haven’t noticed voices or sounds when nobody else is around.
Over the past several months, have you been feeling persistently down or depressed?
I’m not sure I’d say depressed. I’ve been frustrated and stressed about what’s going on, but not persistently down.
Have you ever felt like an outside force or other people could control your thoughts or actions?
No. I don’t feel like anyone can control my thoughts or make me do things.
Outside of this situation at work, do you generally find yourself having trouble trusting friends, family, or romantic partners?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed that being a general problem with friends or family.
